parameters.query: SELECT outbox_id,dedupe_key,action,notion_page_id,subscription_title,vendor,product_plan,account_email,status,amount_cents,currency,billing_cycle,monthly_equivalent_cents,renewal_date,cancellation_deadline,auto_renew,payment_source_label,usage_state,confidence,human_review_needed,evidence_link,validated_by,validation_hash FROM run006_subscription_register_outbox WHERE state='READY' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 25;

nodes.name: Read Validated Register Outbox
nodes.notes: Read-only against the validated Run 006 outbox. Bind the existing private PostgreSQL credential on-host.

parameters.jsCode: const out=[]; for(const item of $input.all()){const x=item.json||{}; const violations=[]; if(x.validated_by!=='SUB-OPS-RUNTIME-006') violations.push('validator'); if(!x.validation_hash) violations.push('validation_hash'); if(!['CREATE','UPDATE'].includes(x.action)) violations.push('action'); if(x.action==='UPDATE'&&!x.notion_page_id) violations.push('notion_page_id'); if(!x.subscription_title||!x.vendor||!x.product_plan) violations.push('identity'); if(!['High','Medium','Low'].includes(x.confidence)) violations.push('confidence'); if(violations.length){out.push({json:{...x,commitStatus:'Rejected',violations}}); continue;} const props={Subscription:x.subscription_title,Vendor:x.vendor,'Product / Plan':x.product_plan,Status:x.status,Currency:x.currency,'Billing Cycle':x.billing_cycle,Confidence:x.confidence,'Human Review Needed':x.human_review_needed?'__YES__':'__NO__','Auto Renew':x.auto_renew?'__YES__':'__NO__','Usage State':x.usage_state,'Evidence Link':x.evidence_link||null,'Payment Source Label':x.payment_source_label||'', 'Account Email':x.account_email||null}; if(Number.isInteger(x.amount_cents)) props.Amount=x.amount_cents/100; if(Number.isInteger(x.monthly_equivalent_cents)) props['Monthly Equivalent']=x.monthly_equivalent_cents/100; if(x.renewal_date){props['date:Renewal Date:start']=String(x.renewal_date).slice(0,10);props['date:Renewal Date:is_datetime']=0;} if(x.cancellation_deadline){props['date:Cancellation Deadline:start']=String(x.cancellation_deadline).slice(0,10);props['date:Cancellation Deadline:is_datetime']=0;} props['date:Last Verified:start']=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); props['date:Last Verified:is_datetime']=0; out.push({json:{outboxId:x.outbox_id,dedupeKey:x.dedupe_key,action:x.action,notionPageId:x.notion_page_id,validationHash:x.validation_hash,commitStatus:'Accepted',properties:props}});} return out;
